title: Registration of Brokers
text: Registration of Brokers May 21, 1998| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIASECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENTMittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor,224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMD/DBA-II/Cir-15/98May 21, 1998 The President/Executive Director/Managing Directorof all Stock Exchanges Dear Sir, Sub : Registration Of Brokers It has been observed that most of the Stock Exchanges are not furnishing the information regarding details of fee remittance by the transferor to SEBI in the format forwarded vide our Circular Ref SMD/MDP/2719/96 dated July 10, 1996, (copy enclosed) resulting in delay in registration. All Exchanges are therefore required to adhere to the said format and certify that the transferor has paid SEBI turnover fees for all the previous years including that related to transactions of the current year and that there are no fee dues payable to SEBI by the transferor member. Wherever court cases are pending, the Exchanges should certify that the transferor has paid all fees due, as per the court order. Yours faithfully, M. D. PATELEXECUTIVE DIRECTOR Encl : copy of circular dated 10.7.96
